# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **Stronger hash seed generation**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp now initializes its shared hash-code seed from the operating system's cryptographic random-number generator. The shared implementation also serves HarfBuzzSharp. Hash codes remain stable within a process and randomized between processes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Cryptographic hash seed initialization** — The shared HashCode implementation in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp uses RandomNumberGenerator instead of System.Random for its per-process seed. First use now loads System.Security.Cryptography; hash codes remain stable within the process. — ❤️ [@rolfbjarne](https://github.com/rolfbjarne) ([#5408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5408))
